summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase and execute-phase workflows end-to-end for Phase 45 (Desktop FUSE write-durability cleanup), a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code with 7 scope items and no behavior change.
summary.outcome: Planning fully completed (6 plans across 5 waves, committed to feat/desktop-fuse-write-durability-cleanup). Execution began and completed Wave 1 (45-01 test safety net, 45-02 journal-dir helper) and was mid-way through Wave 2 (45-03 Option<String> sentinel) when the transcript ends.

repo: The FUSE crate is named `cipherbox-fuse` with default feature `fuse`; cargo test command is `cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse --features fuse`.
Dead-code warnings in `fuse_abi.rs` are pre-existing in the vendored `fuser` ABI file and unrelated to any changes in this phase.
The Windows `fuse/windows/mod.rs` is `cfg`-excluded on macOS, causing a rust-analyzer 'unlinked-file' diagnostic that is not an error.
A third duplicate of the journal-dir helper existed in `fuse/windows/mod.rs` beyond what the original scope identified — discovered during 45-02 execution.
`.planning/config.json` has `auto_advance: true`, which would auto-chain plan-phase into execute-phase without user confirmation.
The Rust API surface extractor (used in step 7.9) returns 0 symbols for Rust crates — it only covers non-Rust languages.
Waves 2–5 all serialize on `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs`, making worktree parallelism unsafe even though worktrees were technically enabled.

code.finding: Pre-existing dead-code warnings from vendored fuser ABI — not introduced by this phase.
Contains a third duplicate of the journal-dir/max-retries logic not listed in the original scope, discovered and consolidated during plan 45-02.

workflow: GSD plan-phase spawns sequential agents (researcher → planner → plan-checker) and commits each artifact (RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, PATTERNS.md, plans, ROADMAP/STATE) in separate atomic commits.
plan-checker non-blocking warnings (RESEARCH.md missing RESOLVED marker, VALIDATION.md template placeholders) should be fixed immediately after verification rather than deferred.
Worktrees are enabled by config but the execute-phase workflow correctly degrades to sequential-on-feature-branch when multiple waves share a hot file like lib.rs.
The tests-first plan (45-01) acts as a behavior-preservation oracle and must land in Wave 1 before any refactor waves begin.
Gap analysis returns clean when no CONTEXT.md exists and requirements use prose req-ids — this is expected, not a failure.

friction: Commit helper script returns a false-negative `commit_failed` status even when lint-staged succeeds, requiring a follow-up `git log` to confirm the commit actually landed.
Rust API surface extractor (step 7.9) returns 0 symbols for Rust crates — silently skipped, but wastes a shell call and could mislead if not caught.
VALIDATION.md template placeholders were not caught until the plan-checker verification pass, requiring a separate edit+commit cycle after the fact.
RESEARCH.md Open Questions heading missing `(RESOLVED)` marker was flagged as a non-blocking warning by the checker — ideally the researcher agent would emit this automatically.
auto_advance: true in config nearly auto-launched execution without user confirmation after planning completed — the assistant correctly paused but the config default creates a footgun.
open_items: Execution incomplete: Wave 2 plan 45-03 (Option<String> sentinel + serde-compat shim) was spawning when the transcript ends; Waves 3–5 (45-04, 45-05, 45-06) not yet started.
Rust API surface extractor should be extended to cover Rust crates so the planner receives real symbol lists for future Rust phases.
Commit helper false-negative bug should be fixed to avoid requiring manual git log verification after every commit.
